compute_sensor_pos: compute position-dependent sensor values for a MuJoCo MJX model and data
compute_sensor_vel: compute velocity-dependent sensor values for a MuJoCo MJX model and data
compute_sensor_acc: compute acceleration and force-dependent sensor values for a MuJoCo MJX model and data
clip_sensor_cutoff: clip sensor values to a specified cutoff threshold based on data type
compute_magnetometer: compute magnetometer sensor values from site orientation and the magnetic field
